Name: Starry Ocean Garden UI Theme -Available in Different Languages-
Author: suzukiPC
Description:
My first UI mod :D inspired by mine and my partner's favourite themes: galaxies, oceans, and gardens! 
This mod was born because I wanted to take a break from another mod I was working on, thinking it'd be quick; but I was terribly mistaken... So I had to commit to it of course!

[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/new%20features.png[/img]

Added compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845]Bigger Backpack[/url] ! I've taken to using it in my current playthrough after it's been brought up in the posts and the misalignment bothered me enough to wanna do something about it; finally got the time for it c:

New config called [b]UI Brightness[/b] :D I had a comment from a while back saying the eyestrain gets to them and I've promised I'd try something when I'm able to, and now I finally did! There are 3 settings total: [b]Default, Desaturated, Even More Desaturated[/b]
I hope these new settings help make this UI even more accessible!

I also fixed some visual inconsistencies from the different language title screens (the birds were left there with the stars, I had to remove the birds). I can't believe I didn't catch them 'til now q.q

[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/how-to-install2.png[/img]

﻿[b]1) [/b]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14525]Theme Manager[/url]** so you can see the font and bar colour changes that suit the mod better (I also recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] if you don't already have it)
[b]2) [/b]Download the file and unzip it; extract it into your [b]Mods[/b] folder
[b]3A) [/b]If you[b] do not[/b] have Generic Mod Config, edit the config.json file of [b]Theme Manager[/b] and add the line [font=Courier New]"StardewTheme": suzukiPC.StarryOceanGardenTheme" [/font]
[b]3B) [/b]If you have both [b]Theme Manager [/b]and [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], set the Theme Manager's theme to Starry Ocean Garden

[i]**Note** The reason why Theme Manager is part of the installation process is because a lot of the in-game text and some of the bars have been edited using Theme Manager. The UI mod will still work without Theme Manager, but some text may be harder to read; plus you won't be getting the full intended experience!

[/i][s][b]4 (Optional) [/b]I have included 2 PNG files inside the assets folder called [b]config-button.png[/b] and [b]keybindings-button.png[/b]; these are for [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] just so the button colours match better with my UI
Just plop the images into GMCM's assets folder, overwrite the files, and you're done :D [/s]Thanks to Khloe Leclaire for helping me implement the patch so that it does that automatically waaah
﻿

[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/cosmetic-changes.png[/img]

✨ Title Screen﻿ and its menu buttons (Available in every language Stardew Valley has to offer!)
✨ Menu Backgrounds
✨ The calendar with the schedule, weather, time, and gold counter
✨ Calendar and Help Wanted Boards
✨ Special Orders Board for Stardew Valley
✨ Bundle Background
✨ Character Dialogue and Portrait Background
✨ The Fishing minigame
✨ Energy Bar and HP Bar colours
✨ Mail icon, and most speech bubbles
✨ Letter background (the one that was default yellow/beige)
✨ The bolded text (from brown to blue)
✨ The in-game text and its drop shadows (some areas probably need tweaking for better visibility, but even those are still pretty readable)
✨ The elevator shaft's floor number buttons in the mines
✨ The colour of the gold coins (I made it more rose gold)
✨ And many more ! (That shouldn't interfere with most recolour mods :D hopefully, at least)

[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/future-plans.png[/img]

✨ Theme Manager is being continuously developed, and as it does, I'll find more ways to customize the text and other special hard-coded things to fit the mod better
✨ That being said, I probably won't add more to this mod (unless it's brought to my attention and I think I can do it/have the time for it) but in the meantime I [i]could[/i] offer stand-alone recolours derived from my UI mod (for example, maybe you want Only my fishing minigame recolour); again, only when brought to my attention [i]and if you ask nicely :'(
[/i][s]✨ I thought about doing 2 more palettes for this mod but I quickly realized just how big the scope was for something like this, so unless I have more free time again I probably won't be doing that[/s] I think I'll be making an entirely different mod post for different palettes for more freedom yes yes
[s]✨ Different languages! I'll have to sit down with this, and I imagine it won't be a single day endeavour, but I'd like to update this mod with Every language within the vanilla game files soon enough c[/s]: Thanks to Nora, Barry, and Khloe helping me out with the stuff you can play in different languages now! 
[s]✨ Cursor toggle! I plan to let players have the default teal for the theme, and an Off toggle so you can have different cursors :)[/s] We have toggle cursors now! You can also turn it off, so you can use different cursors :D
